item.description:
What's Changed in v8.4.1

  • anotherNotch Family Integration: Native two-way IPC interface and URL scheme (anothermusic://) with full playback controls, like/favorite toggling, notch volume sync, and AutoMix/Crossfade cycling.
  • Hero Carousel Trackpad Haptics: Tactile haptic feedback on trackpad horizontal swipes with strict 1-card advance restriction.
  • Gacha & Random Play: Persistent winning track landing, seamless slot reel animations, and candidate preservation.
  • Sparkle 2 Native Updater: Seamless native macOS update dialog, release notes, automatic background downloads, and one-click in-place restart.
  • Support & Donate: GitHub Sponsors and VietQR modal popup matching anotherNotch.
  • Performance & Battery: Resolved high CPU usage with isolated playback progress reporting and detached background animations.
